notes.title: 😅 Yet Another Update 😅
notes.notes:
Game Update Content
Added:
🆕 Additional Hovers on Equipment and Natural Born Trait with additional information like damage ranges
🆕 Visible Int/Mox when choosing from the list of whom to train in Survival Training
🆕 New action icon while using the Silver Feather item
🆕 If an enemy uses an action that tracks a player character, it is now shown by a special indicator around the tracked character. We implemented this to avoid the confusion that happens if you move the tracked character and, by doing so, endanger other characters in the future without knowledge. Examples of tracking actions are Maultigore Tongue Attack or Warden Pike Thrust.
🆕 Removed 4 limit to traits/traumas and limit for max player level. When we extend the campaign in the future, we will need to redesign the leveling system.

notes.title: 🎊 Update + Festival! 🎊
notes.notes:
Game Update Content
Added:
🆕 A new boss, "The Symphony of Shadows" awaits you in the Dome. Its empowered variant and more modifiers are coming in future updates.
🆕 Campaign was extended from 6 to 9 years (will be still longer as we add more content).
🆕 New jump (soul ability) dropped from new boss.
🆕 3 new unique uncraftable armor pieces dropped by the new boss, each empowering the new jump (soul ability).
🆕 1 new uncraftable weapon as a drop from the new boss.
🆕 New German Translation, if you find any missing texts or text going outside of its text field (as German is usually longer than its English counterpart), let us know.

Fixed:
📌 Custom character list in town that lets you drag your characters on the list in whatever order you like, and this order will be remembered for the rest of your campaign
📌 Town remembered what type of sorting character list was left in, and returns to it after battle/loading
📌 Buffed Warden stats to reflect the longer campaign
📌 Minor bug where some lines after the first one, while hovering stuff inventory, had unnecessary space at the beginning.
📌 Hammer having unintentional invulnerability during attack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/be5f9baddc4ca97c4945f9b1fdfdf589fd7660e3.gif
Very Important! Please Read!
Feedback for the new boss is highly encouraged. We tried to do something unique with this boss, making it a "4v4" fight. Let us know what you think!
If you have any ideas about what we could do for "Symphony of Shadows" modifiers or empowered variants, let us know. We read all the feedback we get. :)

"Symphony of Shadows" is set to spawn between years 2-6.
Until the next patch we will set it so that the new boss ALWAYS spawns as a choice at year 2. Rest of the years, it has the same chance to spawn as the rest of the bosses.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/6e7d63fd9d34d1ea6a5ae85a4674bf4532227c22.gif
To illustrate the difficulty curve we had in the game till this moment:
There were 4 normal enemies (level 1) and 4 empowered variants of them (level 2). Each enemy and its empowered variant have fight modifiers that would make fights harder. Fights with modifiers can be counted as having +0.5 difficulty level, so:
Level 1 - Maultigore, Caretaker, Starchild, Galvera
Level 1.5 - Level 1 fights with various modifiers
Level 2 - Vulcanic Maultigore, Carnivorous Caretaker, Fallen Angel, Khepri Weaver Galvera
Level 2.5 - Level 2 fights with various modifiers
Level 3 - Final Boss fight

Following this allotment:
Base "Symphony of Shadows" is a Level 1.5 fight, and their fight with modifiers is a Level 2 fight. It is the "in-between" difficulty boss that will let us spread the campaign longer.
The next new boss added in the future will probably be in the same difficulty space and will let us make campaigns longer and more fulfilling.
In the future, adding empowered variants to these new bosses (the empowered variant would be Level 2.5 and one with modifiers Level 3) would allow us to make campaigns even longer and upgrade the final boss to Level 3.5.
After that, the next step would be adding more stuff to town to make the longer town progression interesting.

The first update of 2025 is here! Dive deeper into the madness with new languages, Quality of life improvments, and fixes.

[hr][/hr]

🌍 New Language 🌍
Tarnished Blood welcomes two new lenguages:

  Brazilian – A Cúpula está à sua espera
  Spanish – La Cúpula aguarda tu llegada


What’s New?

🆕 Escape Battle – Trigger a cryptic event by fleeing (1 choice for now, more soon!).
🆕 Cancel Level-Ups – No regrets. Back out of upgrades freely.
🆕 Camera Controls with WSAD – Early keyboard support for tactical maneuvering.


🧑‍🔧 Fixes

📌 Steal Fortitude – Now works against Wounded Beast.
📌 Events & the Dead – Wyld Lust/Caretaker no longer target corpses.
📌 Description Clarity – Traits/Traumas explained better.
📌 Diseased Trauma – The infection behaves… as intended.
📌 Octophobia – Fear of "8" now includes 18, 28, etc.
📌 Maultigore’s Belly – Survival text no longer lies.
📌 Replay Stability – Crush Maultigore, replay endlessly.


[hr][/hr]
The Dome watches. Stay vigilant. 🔪
~The Juggler Games Team

notes.notes:
💌 Summary 💌
Hello there yet again! Today we come to you with lots of goodies. In a nutshell: tons of patches, a bit of viral on the youtube,, and support for Steam Achievements!

🔎 Update Log 🔎
📌 Streamlined how portals are placed.
📌 Fixed player placing teleport on game pad
📌 Fixed upgrading cost for boss - crafted weapons
📌 Fixed Warden pushing back players outside of range
📌 Fixed Warden Soul harpoons spawning outside of area making invisible hit boxes
📌 Fixed level up screen eating EXP if player quit to menu while choosing trait
📌 Fixed RNG on levelling so that character always get same level up trait options
📌 Changed "Handyman" and "Naked Fighting" traits applying when departing from town instead of just applying whenever characters inventory changed
📌 Changed "Iron Will" trait description to better indicate when the toughness is applied
📌 Fixed character names being randomised if loading save file from fight that took more than 1 turn
📌 Fixed crash on warden connected with him dying while pike attack was on timeline
📌 Fixed loaded fights were loading amour state from moment player quit to menu instead of beginning of the  battle
📌 Fixed crash on Caretaker when there was a pike attack in turn the boss was killed while clone was present on scene.
📌 Fixed pike points not hitting Caretaker clone same turn it is summoned if some action before recalculates timeline.
📌 Fixed bug with Consumable Amazon Quest giving multiple rewards
📌 Fixed bug with EXP Amazon Quest having wrong description
📌 Fixed Amazon achievements not working on Man that were born during campaign
📌 Fixed Sex Addict trait not working correctly, also buffed it and changed wording on it's description
📌 Temporary fix to problems with menu and town inputs scrolling endlessly
📌 Fixed pacifist debuff not saving
📌 Fixed petrify debuff not saving
📌 Fixed petrified character being used for targeting during enemies first turn
📌 Fixed Soulbound trauma not working correctly
📌 Fixed vines dealing damage with it's tip even when destroyed after some recalculations
📌 Fixed gathering resources as Divine tribe not checking if you have enough Protector Tears making it infinite

📢 New Stuff 📢
Steam Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/1d09151862b5ec5f78d96f7b87be8ab2fe519de2.gif
Yup! Now all ingame achivs have their Steam equivalents. And they count toward global achievements. 

Discord Activities Integration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/a7bacd6095aec30a5217d9249eebb8526a528486.gif
So now you can stalk your buddies if they are playing Tarnished Blood, and for how long and how far they have gotten.

Tribe requirement for achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/39080cd805dd7dfb311331a31efcce5b34cef3f8.png
As requested by so many of you. So now it is a bit more understandable how to get them. Which should be handy, considering our in-game achievements affect the gameplay.

Making Waves
The biggest thanks go to Splattercatgaming! You've sent an entire legion of truly marvelous people our way. Saying we are grateful is a huge understatement. Thank you, Mr Splattercat! 🖖🏼
[previewyoutube=PxkyU7YmZiE;full][/previewyoutube]
Of course, Splattercat being the biggest of the bunch - was hardly alone, and we appreciate each and every YouTubers and Streamers that showcased our game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/c422d9d0f72bde01878c8a08051dbc44b5258984.gif

📢 End Word 📢
As always, thank you. For everything. We can't say we managed to conquer Steam yet, but we are slowly climbing up there. 
Which none of it would be possible without you, writing reviews, giving feedback and suggestions, spreading the word, and giving us all those tons of energy.

With sincere gratitude, yours truly,
~The Juggler Games Team

notes.title: 🛠 Major Update & Patch 🛠
notes.notes:
💌 The Message 💌
First and foremost - THANK YOU to all our fans, supporters, reviewers, players and testers.
You rained soooo much feedback on us and we can't stop being busy :)

Special thanks goes to Blank who wrote us a beautiful chunk of read (check it HERE) 

Know that we are working around the clock to fix/adjust everything your report ASAP and we are endlessly grateful and glad we managed to attract such a responsive and supportive crowd.

Your reaction and support, to quote the classic, was and is "breathtaking".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/3496e3cc910c69ae927c2a34514cfaa90b2c153f.gif

But enough of the sweet talk and lets get down to business >:D

🛠 The Changes 🛠
✔️ We’ve identified and resolved the issue causing a massive frame rate drop during battles. Thank you for your feedback and patience while we worked on this fix. The game should now run much smoother across all configurations.
✔️ Fixed year 6 save from town created unusable save
✔️ Fixed quitting to the menu while fighting the final boss resulted in loading to a different fight
✔️ Fixed unusable "back to menu" button on the campaign winning screen
✔️ Fixed quitting the menu on the campaign winning screen by pausing menu options
✔️ Fixed typos
✔️ Made credits go way faster
✔️ Black Clouds event fixed to avoid confusion on who got what and why
✔️ Fixed Crimson Shield knocking enemies away
✔️ Fixed Pike targets showing incorrectly on Warden
✔️ Fixed some minor animation details on Warden
✔️ Fixed missing break line in All Eyes On Me event
✔️ Fixed bug causing some keyboard characters to quit the process of naming characters
✔️ Fixed achievements after the final boss not being saved 
✔️ Fixed game not saving in village when quitting to menu

📢 What Comes Next 📢
We continue collecting reports and feedback and we invite you to get even more involved! Be it by reviews, or our discord or Steam forums. Don't be shy to voice your opinion.
This is what Early Access is for! :D 
We ain't making games for ourselves but for you, our dear players.
Yell at us all day long! Do not bite your tongue and left no stone unturned!
I assure you - no opinion will be left ignored or discarded. 

Be it bugs, or balancing issues, feature request or anything that comes to your mind - know we are hungry for exactly that.
That's what makes, making games, worth doing.

notes.title: PAX East 2024 and new update (a BIG one)!
notes.notes:
Are you in Boston for PAX East 2024? Be sure to come by, try the game in new, improved build and say hi to us!

You can find Tarnished Blood at TWO booths this year:

- Galaktus Publishing at #14049
- Games From Poland at #18084

What can you get from visiting us? The chance to play the game (duh) and a chance to talk face to face with a man behind the idea of Tarnished Blood and let him watch you struggle against a new boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082789/5357543132226b1a161ef1290020bff17281fa50.png

What's more is that you can get a specially designed card and a chance to grab a pin in two different designs!

Oh and if you want to keep up to date with our daily news from the PAX be sure to follow us on Twitter (click me, im a link to the profile)


Can't visit PAX?
We have prepared something also for you all.

As you know we are constantly working on improving the game that's why now you can try the new and improved version. What has changed? here's the list: 

-Added Gamepad and Steam Deck support - Game should be 100% playable both on Gamepad and Steam Deck, in the upcoming weeks we will continue to work on making this control scheme more streamlined.

-Added hovers to on-screen damage “circles” during fights.

-New designs for hovers on boss parts showing with more clarity what types of damage is it vulnerable/resistant to.

-Added “Future Vision” - System enabling view of future when setting action without confirming it. This should enable easier small adjustments to actions like attacks or jumps without progressing the action blocking vine.

-Added prediction to action blocking vine - When hovering or setting action you can see how much the action blocking vine will progress if the action is confirmed.

-Added additional “Confirm/Cancel” buttons when setting actions.

-Added option to disable action blocking vine growth - Feature requested on steam forums.

-Added resolution and fullscreen options.

-Remade town progression:
--Removed Action Points in Town.
--All events are “free” but disable at least one interacting character making it unable to hunt or interact with other events until the next town phase.
--Added upgrades to all buildings using rare obsidian resources.
--Added ability to upgrade gear in upgraded crafting buildings(this feature is still in development so its UI and balancing is not finalised yet).
--Changed how level-ups and INT/MOX levels work. Level ups now give one of three traits to choose from, INT/MOX levels give their appropriate hunt bonus and one random basic statistic.

-Minimizing the game turns on the pause menu, it’s now always possible to pause game by pressing ESC anywhere in game.

Fixes:

-Fixed stronger variants of enemies having the same name as standard versions.
-Unified bullets names.
-Unified in fight damaging effects hovers.
-Fixed low resolution images of weapons, armors, potions in crafting.
-Fixed broken resolutions now with ability to change them without quitting to the menu.
-Fixed possible blockers when fast clicking stuff during tutorial.
-Fixed crash when fighting Caretaker with only one character.
-Fixed crash when death of character during battle(by getting fifth wound) would simultaneously trigger death by “Feeble Chest” trauma causing one character to die twice.
-Fixed crash during second turn in tutorial if it was triggered twice(after quitting to the menu).
-Fixed effect of “Pact of the Dead” giving buffs to characters without Life Path if the person that dies didn't have one either.
-Fixed Embark button not triggering properly if popups are disabled in the menu.
-Fixed name of button triggering movie replay of whole fight, also added this button to the summary screen after victory.
-Fixed crash that would trigger if the menu was opened during replay.
-Fixed crash that would trigger if the killing blow was dealt with by someone without a weapon.
-Fixed various translation typos and inconsistencies.
-Build size reduced by over 1 GB

Known Problems:

-There may be come inconsistencies in what few of traits/traumas/wounds effects do and what their descriptions are, fixing these inconsistencies and streamlining effect as well as reworking wounds system is our next priority
-All new upgrade related events in town have default event graphics
